name: What causes stucco to crack and chip?

mainEntity.name: What causes stucco to crack and chip?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stucco cracking and chipping are commonly caused by a variety of factors, including foundation movement, moisture penetration, and normal thermal expansion and contraction due to temperature changes. Impact damage, improper mixing or application during original installation, and even seismic activity can also contribute to stucco deterioration. Addressing these underlying causes during repair is crucial for a lasting solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stucco cracks and chips are often caused by foundation movement, moisture, temperature changes, or impact damage.
